title: proof-coverage-probes-report-to-the-watch
intention: Every standing WATCHME probe berthed in cairn/tools/proof_coverage reports to harbor_master's watch verb with {ticket, holds, finding} stated against its own ticket's falsifier, and each spec names that receiver.
why: Every standing probe in cairn/tools/proof_coverage mails with no verb and nothing uses it (835b5736bf2b D2); a88d6a368cfb built the watch verb that uses a WATCHME finding and 8ecb99998254 built watch_carry. Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a: build the receivers.
traces_to: 835b5736bf2b's falsifier (zero probe-bearing standing specs lack a receiver) and Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a; the 2026-09-30 ruling that a probe's data must have a consumer that USES it; RULE 1 (the build stays inside cairn/tools/proof_coverage; base's helper through its public interface, harbor_master through its bus verb)
how: Measured 2026-10-03: 1 tickets at a rest carry a watchme probe under cairn/tools/proof_coverage/probes/ (c5b6b128a376). Read 2026-10-03: one standing ticket (c5b6b128a376) carries a probe under cairn/tools/proof_coverage/probes, sieve_predicts_unran, posting to='harbor_master' with no verb (verbless mail reaches the base receive, which only logs). Its trigger is fails-shaped: TRUE when a proof ran unpredicted by the sieve. Probe-importing proofs: cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proofs/test_call_time_binding.py. Each PROBE gets verb='watch' and carry=watch_carry(<its id>, _carry, <its predicate>), importing watch_carry from cairn.tools.base.probe (declared public). Each ticket's watchme spec gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} through the artifact door. A proof under cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proofs reads the population from the commons and asserts each probe's verb, to, and live payload invariants.
falsifier: GREEN when every ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme.probe sits under cairn/tools/proof_coverage has a probe whose PROBE posts verb 'watch' to 'harbor_master' and whose payload over live data carries ticket == that ticket's id, holds a bool, and a non-empty finding whenever holds is False; and every such spec names receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} with watchme_spec_error naming no receiver fault. RED if any standing proof_coverage spec lacks the receiver, or if a converted payload's ticket is a path or another id. WRONG INTENT if a proof_coverage probe's data has a reader other than its own ticket's FIXME that only Akien could name.
watchme: none, because what this child's probes say is read by harbor_master's watch verb (a88d6a368cfb, PROVED), and whether they ever fire is 164da559823d's and acb4ecd84364's watch (CairnCommons/tickets/164da559823d-*.json); a probe on probes reporting would need a receiver of its own.
children: none, because the change is 1 PROBE declarations and their specs, all inside cairn/tools/proof_coverage.
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) Which probes and how: c5b6b128a376 sieve_predicts_unran (fails=_trigger). In each file under cairn/tools/proof_coverage/probes/: append watch_carry to the existing 'from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...' line; use the probe's id constant (named per probe below, added as `_TICKET_ID = "<id>"` after the import block when absent); in PROBE = Probe(...) replace 'carry=_carry,' with 'verb="watch",' and 'carry=watch_carry(<const>, _carry, <pred>),'. sieve_predicts_unran: no ticket constant; gains _TICKET_ID = "c5b6b128a376". Nothing else in a probe changes. (2) watch_carry exists in cairn/tools/base/probe.py (8ecb99998254); do not edit it. (3) Specs: each ticket's watchme spec whose probe starts with cairn/tools/proof_coverage/probes/ gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'}, through cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write. (4) Proof: cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proofs/test_proof_coverage_probes_report_to_the_watch.py, PROVES {'51e5a167281f': {'all': 'test_proof_coverage_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}, modeled on cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py. (5) Every proof that imports a converted probe stays green: run them.

decisions.text: D1: the probes — In each of these files under cairn/tools/proof_coverage/probes/: sieve_predicts_unran.py (c5b6b128a376: constant _TICKET_ID — add it; fails=_trigger) — append watch_carry to the existing `from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...` line; where the constant is to be added, add `<constant> = "<its id>"` after the import block; in `PROBE = Probe(...)` replace `carry=_carry,` with `verb="watch",` and `carry=watch_carry(<constant>, _carry, <its predicate>),`. sieve_predicts_unran: no ticket constant; gains _TICKET_ID = "c5b6b128a376". watch_carry's signature (cairn/tools/base/probe.py): watch_carry(ticket_id: str, carry=None, *, fails=None, holds=None), exactly one of fails=/holds= given as a keyword. <its predicate> is the literal keyword argument named in the parentheses above for that file: `fails=_trigger` passes the probe's existing module-level `_trigger` function (the same one already given to Probe as trigger=); `holds=_holds` passes a `_holds` function defined as stated in this decision. Nothing else changes; watch_carry is not edited.

D2: the proof — Create cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proofs/test_proof_coverage_probes_report_to_the_watch.py: a copy of cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py with the docstring naming cairn/tools/proof_coverage and ticket 51e5a167281f; PROVES = {'51e5a167281f': {'all': 'test_proof_coverage_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}; BERTH = 'cairn/tools/proof_coverage/probes/'; _REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] (the repo root: the directory holding cairn/); teeth renamed test_every_standing_proof_coverage_probe_posts_watch, test_every_standing_proof_coverage_spec_names_the_receiver and the composite test_proof_coverage_probes_report_to_the_watch. Structure, in full: imports importlib, json, subprocess, sys, Path; _REPO_ROOT on sys.path; parse_workflow from cairn.tools.base.transitions; watchme_spec_error from cairn.tools.base.watchme_spec; _main_tree() = Path(git -C _REPO_ROOT rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir).parent falling back to _REPO_ROOT; _tickets() = _main_tree().parent/'CairnCommons'/'tickets'; _standing() = (id, doc, spec) for each ticket whose parse_workflow(doc['workflow_and_state']).here is 'PROVED' or 'WATCHME' (a ticket that does not parse is skipped) whose watchme spec's probe starts with BERTH (every such spec: a ticket whose watchme is a list may contribute more than one tuple, and _specs() reads a dict or a list of dicts), asserting non-empty with `assert out, ...`; the posts tooth imports each probe module and asserts PROBE.verb == 'watch', PROBE.to == 'harbor_master', payload({}) carries ticket == the id, holds a bool, non-empty finding when holds is False (invariants only); the receiver tooth asserts spec['receiver'] == {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} and watchme_spec_error(doc) names no receiver fault; a __main__ block runs each, prints PASS/FAIL, exits 1 on any failure. No classes.

D3: the specs' receiver — Ticket files are /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets/<id>-<slug>.json (glob '<id>-*.json', exactly one). For each of c5b6b128a376: doc = json.loads(Path(p).read_text()); the watchme is a dict or list of dicts; every spec whose 'probe' starts with 'cairn/tools/proof_coverage/probes/' (one or several) gets spec['receiver'] = {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'}; then cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(p, json.dumps(doc, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', verb='cast', why='<id>: the watchme names its receiver, harbor_master\'s watch verb (51e5a167281f)') — write(path, text, *, verb, why), text the WHOLE modified ticket. Run it as a script file (a shell command naming a record path and writing is refused by the artifact gate).

D4: green, seal, commit — Run cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proofs/test_proof_coverage_probes_report_to_the_watch.py (exit 0) and the probe-importing proofs (cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proofs/test_call_time_binding.py); each must be green. Seal with `bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 900 cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proofs/test_proof_coverage_probes_report_to_the_watch.py <the probe-importing proofs>` (it runs each and writes its validation beside it). Commit with message '51e5a167281f: proof_coverage probes report to the watch' (the commit runs the reseal ladder, so allow an hour); commit the commons.

Each named probe file exists on disk (read 2026-10-03) with a `from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...` line to which watch_carry is appended, and a `PROBE = Probe(...)` call holding `carry=_carry,`, which is replaced as stated. Every probe in this ticket passes fails=_trigger, so no _holds function is defined here.

The proof is created by copying the existing file cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py byte for byte (cp), then making ONLY the modifications this ticket lists (docstring, PROVES, BERTH, _REPO_ROOT depth, the three tooth names, plus any tooth this ticket adds). No generator script exists or is used: any earlier mention of child.py names a scratch script of the caster, not something the builder runs. The posts tooth obtains each payload as PROBE.payload({}) — Probe.payload runs the carry over that context.

The receiver is set by ONE Python script file the builder writes in the session scratchpad and runs: for each ticket id it globs the one ticket file, json-loads it, sets spec["receiver"] on every watchme spec whose probe starts with the berth path, and calls cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(path, json.dumps(doc, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", verb="cast", why=...). A shell command naming a record path while writing is refused by the artifact gate, which is why it is a script file.

MEASURED 2026-10-04 (grep -rln sieve_predicts_unran --include=*.py over /home/akien/dev/src/cairn, excluding the probe file; plus 'proof_coverage.probes'/'proof_coverage/probes'): COMPLETE SET of proofs importing /home/akien/dev/src/cairn/cairn/tools/proof_coverage/probes/sieve_predicts_unran.py is exactly /home/akien/dev/src/cairn/cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proofs/test_call_time_binding.py — the sole one; test_proof_coverage.py and proofs/fixtures/ do not name it.
